headline: Landslide kills 14 at Ethiopia monastery during prayer service
summary: A hillside collapsed onto the Tsadqane Debre Mitmaq St Mary Monastery in Amhara, where worshippers had gathered overnight.
script: A landslide in northern Ethiopia has killed fourteen people at a mountain monastery. The hillside collapsed during an overnight prayer service, and rescue efforts for anyone still trapped have now been halted.
imageAlt: Coffins draped in cloth laid before Orthodox clergy after the landslide at the monastery.
imageAltTwo: Grieving relatives and worshippers gather at the monastery following the disaster.
